title: `TextMessageTermination` Condition
body:
### Confirmation

- [x] I confirm that I am a maintainer and so can use this template. If I am not, I understand this issue will be closed and I will be asked to use a different template.

### Issue body

A termination condition that stops the team when a `TextMessage` is emitted from a specific source, or any source.

For example, to terminate when a specific agent produced a `TextMessage`:

```python
TextMessageTermination(source="assistant")
```

To terminate when any agent produced a `TextMessage`

```python
TextMessageTermination()
```

- In `Swarm` group chat team, it is useful to terminate the team when an agent no longer hands off or producing tool call results. https://github.com/microsoft/autogen/issues/5611#issuecomment-2676776854
- In a single agent scenario, often useful to repeatedly call the same agent in a `RoundRobinGroupChat` until it stops producing tool call results. https://github.com/microsoft/autogen/issues/5621#issuecomment-2685121464


For example

```python
assistant = AssistantAgent(...)
team = RoundRobinGroupChat([assistant], termination_condition=TextMessageTermination())
result = team.run(...)
```
